title: Let Them Show You Who They Are
coreMove: When you choose love instead of chasing it, mixed signals read as a no, and you stop spending your energy on someone who keeps proving they will not show up.

exampleSpecs.domain: Source case: Dating apps as competition
exampleSpecs.audience: Carys and readers facing choosing versus chasing love
exampleSpecs.stakes: Trying to win dating can undermine being genuinely chosen.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show Carys using choosing versus chasing love in the source case without controlling another person.
